people.name: Gibeah
people.line: A city of Benjamin, associated with Saul and atrocities.

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Then the messengers came to Gibeah of Saul, and spoke these words in the ears of the people, then all the people lifted up their voice, and wept.
translations.bsb: When the messengers came to Gibeah of Saul and relayed these words in the hearing of the people, they all wept aloud.
translations.kjv: Then came the messengers to Gibeah of Saul, and told the tidings in the ears of the people: and all the people lifted up their voices, and wept.
translations.asv: Then came the messengers to Gibeah of Saul, and spake these words in the ears of the people: and all the people lifted up their voice, and wept.
